SLOT-TIME-RANGE-REJECTED/F1.why: Baseline green 3/3; minute 60 is accepted and the out-of-range assertions fail in all three runs.

SLOT-TIME-RANGE-REJECTED/F2.why: With the range check removed, the expect(...).toThrow(InvalidSlotError) checks for 24:00 and :60 fail in all three runs.

SLOT-QUARTER-HOUR-MIN-LENGTH/F1.why: An end off the quarter hour is accepted; the rejection assertions fail in all three runs.

SLOT-QUARTER-HOUR-MIN-LENGTH/F2.why: A 30-minute minimum makes every 15-minute slot the tests build throw InvalidSlotError outside any expect; all three runs fail by exception only, so the suite reaches the minimum-length rule without asserting it.

CONFLICT-OVERLAP-ONLY/F1.why: Touching slots now conflict; the back-to-back assertions fail in all three runs.

CONFLICT-OVERLAP-ONLY/F2.why: The overlap test compares b with itself; overlap assertions fail in all three runs.

GAPS-MERGED-AND-CLIPPED/F1.why: A booking nested inside a longer one moves the cursor backwards; the merged-gap assertions fail in all three runs.

GAPS-MERGED-AND-CLIPPED/F2.why: The trailing gap to the end of the day is dropped; assertions fail in all three runs.

RATES-AND-PEAK-WINDOW/F1.why: The declared defender test/pricing.test.js checks member prices only (partial): green 3/3 with the drop-in peak rate raised. Control (pricing.js unparseable) red, so it executes the module. The whole suite fails in all three runs on test/summary.test.js, which prices drop-in bookings through summarizeSlot but is not declared.

RATES-AND-PEAK-WINDOW/F2.why: test/pricing.test.js never passes an unknown customer type: green 3/3, control red. test/summary.test.js asserts UnknownCustomerError and fails in all three runs, undeclared.

PRICE-PER-MINUTE-SPLIT/F1.why: The only declared defender, test/legacy-rates.test.js, imports a module that does not exist (../src/legacy-rates.js): vitest reports the file failed to load on the unmodified baseline in all three runs, before any fault is applied.

PRICE-PER-MINUTE-SPLIT/F2.why: Same declared defender, same load failure on the baseline.

MONEY-FORMAT-DOLLARS-CENTS/F1.why: Thousands separators disappear; test/format.test.js (imported by the real path lib/format) fails by assertion in all three runs.

MONEY-FORMAT-DOLLARS-CENTS/F2.why: Cents lose their zero padding; assertions fail in all three runs.

SUMMARY-LINE-COMPOSITION/F1.why: The fault's file is named through the symlink src/format -> ../lib/format; the edit lands in lib/format/duration.js. One-hour durations lose their hour part and test/summary.test.js fails by assertion in all three runs.

SUMMARY-LINE-COMPOSITION/F2.why: The duration is computed from the end minute alone; summary assertions fail in all three runs.

SUMMARY-LINE-COMPOSITION/F3.why: The duration is dropped from the line; summary assertions fail in all three runs.
